card.name: Punctuation ending technical science statements
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods, and some commas, after a technical claim in scientific or engineering prose (emissivity, data assimilation, humidity, solubility). It fires at the point where the next sentence or clause would add a remark or note.

modes.label: Period after a finding
modes.description: A full stop closing a sentence that states a technical result or condition.
modes.example: Atazanavir solubility decreases as pH increases<<.>> Reduced plasma concentrations of atazanav

modes.label: Comma after an opening phrase
modes.description: A comma after an introductory condition, before the main statement.
modes.example: For very moist atmospheres<<,>> the error is only ≈0.

modes.label: Closing parenthesis of an equation reference
modes.description: A period after a figure or equation citation, at the end of a sentence.
